segments.t: 一切权利属于原英文作者，译者不懂植物学，欢迎指正 转载请注明原作者&译者。 原文：ICN 译者：柳下杜拉罕 Soft Rime [注意]：树冰的学名不是“xSedeveria 'Silver Frost' ”，是“xSedeveria‘Soft Rime’ ”。 Origin unknown, probably a Japanese hybrid. 起源不明，可能是日本杂交种。 Parentage : Sedum morganianum x Echeveria spec. 亲本：玉坠X某拟石莲属 In Korea known as xSedeveria 'Subing' and in Japan known as xS. 'Juhyo'. 在韩国被称为xSedeveria 'Subing'在日本被称为xS. 'Juhyo'。 Also known as xS. 'Robert Cream'. "Robert Cream" is obviously a misspelling of "Robert Grimm", the name of a fairly different xSedeveria. 也被称为xS. 'Robert Cream'。"Robert Cream"显然是"Robert Grimm"的拼写错误，这是一个完全不同的xSedeveria的名称。 The flowers of this hybrid resemble those of x Sedeveria 'Morganden', but the habit of the plant is more upright and the colour of the leaves more bluish. It resembles also somewhat xSedeveria‘Harry Butterfield’, but again the latter is not growing upright and lacks the bluish colour of the leaves, also has more reddish flowers. 这个杂交种的花类似于x Sedeveria 'Morganden'’，但植物的通常更直立，叶片颜色更蓝。它也很像千佛手（xSedeveria‘Harry Butterfield’），但是后者不是直立生长叶片也不是那么蓝，也有更多红色的花朵。 Photos Park Kwan-Jae
xS. 'Soft Rime' at left, xS. 'Harry Butterfield' at right 左：树冰，右：千佛手
